Generated spec for data-cells

Usage:
  zqk system data-cells [flags]

Flags:
      --envelope-policy-dry-run   Dry run envelope policies for known storage profiles
      --json                      Output in JSON format
      --json-envelope             Output JSON envelope with operational details
      --kind string               Filter data cells by kind

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
